title: v0.53.6 / v0.53.7 — Plugins live, Anthropic API, tool endpoints
description: Soup CLI v0.53.6 / v0.53.7: SoupPluginCallback attached by the 14 trainers that wire it (for plugins registered in the same process), Anthropic-compatible '/v1/messages' endpoint, n-gram speculative decoding in the generate path (no flag enables it), 'soup data recipe --execute' DAG runner (6 node kinds; since v0.76.0 an llm_text or judge node needs --provider or --offline and exits 2 with neither), '/v1/tools/python' + '/v1/tools/web_search', 6 trainer plugins lazy-imported, heading-aware Markdown ingest, AOT preprocess to Arrow shards.

headings.title: v0.53.7 — Data Recipe DAG live runner

blocks.html:
v0.53.6 / v0.53.7 — Plugins live, Anthropic API, tool endpoints

v0.53.6 — SoupPluginCallback live

The v0.45.0 BasePlugin protocol is now wired into every HF Trainer via SoupPluginCallback. One bad plugin can't crash training — exceptions in plugin hooks are caught and logged, the trainer keeps going.

A plugin takes effect when your own Python entry point calls register_plugin(...) and then runs the trainer in the same process, as the Plugin System page shows. soup plugins list, enable and disable run in a process of their own and see nothing that a stock soup command registered, and nothing is auto-discovered at startup, so soup train on its own never fans Trainer events into a plugin you installed.

(Since closed in v0.76.0: Soup now discovers installed distributions that publish the soup_cli.plugins entry-point group, when you run soup plugins and again when a training run builds the plugin callback. A third-party entry point stays disabled, with none of its code imported, until you run soup plugins enable <name>, which saves the opt-in in ~/.soup/plugins.json and imports it. soup plugins install now exits 2 and installs nothing. See Discovery and opt-in.)

Anthropic-compatible /v1/messages endpoint

blocks.code:
soup serve --model ./output --backend transformers
# POST http://localhost:8000/v1/messages — Anthropic Messages shape

blocks.html:
v0.53.6 ships the transformers backend; v0.53.7 adds vLLM parity plus Anthropic-shape SSE streaming.

N-gram speculative decoding

prompt_lookup_num_tokens is plumbed through _generate_response, so n-gram (prompt-lookup) decoding can stand in as a draft where a draft model is overkill. It is a Python-level hook: no soup serve flag or soup.yaml key builds the n-gram config at v0.77.0 (nothing outside utils/ngram_spec.py constructs one), so the server cannot turn it on (see Plugin System).

v0.53.7 — Data Recipe DAG live runner

Runs the validated DAG node by node, in topological order. Through v0.75.2, from the CLI the llm_text and judge nodes were offline stubs: the command passed no provider, so llm_text wrote llm_text(offline): <rendered prompt> into each row and judge passed every row with true, silently. The provider path (ollama, anthropic, vllm) existed only on the Python function run_recipe, which also takes resume=True; the CLI has no resume option.

(Since closed in v0.76.0, #817 and #922: soup data recipe --execute takes --provider ollama|anthropic|vllm with optional --model and --base-url, or the explicit opt-in --offline for the placeholder behaviour. A recipe with an llm_text or judge node and neither flag exits 2 and writes nothing. The full rules are under Data Recipe DAG.) The six node kinds:

  • seed — load a starting JSONL (config.path, under the working directory, not a symlink)
  • llm_text — config.prompt, formatted per row; placeholder text under --offline, as above
  • code — RLVR-sandbox code execution (config.code)
  • judge — keeps the rows an LLM judge answers OK to; with --offline it keeps every row
  • validator — keeps rows that match config.regex (tested against config.field, default text) and/or validate against a JSON Schema in config.schema (applied to the whole row; needs the jsonschema package). At least one of the two is required; there is no pydantic mode
  • sampler — writes every row it receives to <output>/<node-name>.jsonl; it does not subsample

A recipe is a YAML file of nodes and edges. This one runs end to end offline with soup data recipe --execute --offline --output ./out recipe.yaml (without --offline or --provider it exits 2, because it has an llm_text and a judge node) and writes ./out/out.jsonl:

Node names match [a-z0-9][a-z0-9_-]*. At most 256 nodes, 1,024 edges and a 1 MiB file; cycles, self-loops, duplicate edges and unknown node kinds are rejected, and the recipe file must not be a symlink. After each node a checkpoint and a per-node sidecar (.checkpoint.json, .node-<name>.jsonl) are written into the output directory.

Tool endpoints live

blocks.code:
POST /v1/tools/python      # RLVR sandbox + 5s timeout + 512MB RLIMIT; since v0.77.0 501 where OS-level isolation is unavailable
POST /v1/tools/web_search  # bearer-auth; 403 at v0.77.0, see below
POST /v1/tools/bash        # runs under OS-level isolation since v0.74.0; 501 where that isolation is unavailable (Windows included)

blocks.html:
(Since v0.77.0 both code routes need --tool-auth-token on every bind, loopback included, and answer 401 without it, and /v1/tools/python answers 501 wherever /v1/tools/bash does (#2166, #2174). The isolation cuts the network; the code still runs as the server's user. See Inference Server.)

(At v0.77.0 a request to /v1/tools/web_search on the transformers backend that passes the auth (401) and payload (400) checks answers 403 web_search disabled (empty domain allowlist): no flag or config key sets the allowlist, and the search backend returns nothing unless Python code replaces it. The vLLM, SGLang and DeepSpeed-MII backends have no tool routes. See Inference Server.)

Trainer plugins lazy-imported live

6 trainer plugins ship with v0.53.7 lazy-import wiring. (At v0.77.0 nothing calls them: there is no soup.yaml key for them and no command reaches instantiate_trainer_plugins, so the six names are a library allowlist, not something a run can turn on.)

  • grokfast — gradient grokking filter
  • spectrum — top-k parameter selection
  • llmcompressor — compressed inference export
  • sonicmoe — MoE routing acceleration
  • cce_plugin — Cut Cross-Entropy as a plugin
  • math_verify — math RLVR plugin

Markdown + data forge polish

  • soup data ingest now does heading-aware Markdown splits (one JSONL row per section)
  • soup data decontaminate --benchmark-file <path> accepts operator-supplied corpora
  • soup data forge --judge-provider {ollama,anthropic,vllm} live
  • soup data preprocess AOT-tokenizes → Arrow shards (live)
